# Virome Connectivity and Host Systems
## Briseño Lab

## Virome Ecology • Host Impact • Computational Biology

::: {.hero}

Understanding the virome connectivity in agricultural systems and natural ecosystems, and the impact of viruses on their host, implementing comparative genomics, metagenomics, computational biology, and ecological networks.

# Research Areas

## Research Areas

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Virome Ecology](projects/virome-ecology/)

Understanding how viruses shape ecological communities across natural and agricultural systems.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Plant Virology](projects/plant-viromes/)

Discovering, characterizing, and tracking plant viruses using genomics and molecular biology.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Bioinformatics](projects/bioinformatics/)

Developing reproducible computational methods for sequence analysis and pathogen discovery.

:::

::::

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Disease Ecology](projects/disease-ecology/)

Studying pathogen dynamics across hosts, landscapes, and ecosystems.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Microbiome Ecology](projects/microbiome-ecology/)

Investigating interactions among viruses, fungi, bacteria, oomycetes, nematodes, and plants.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### [Forest Pathology](projects/forest-pathology/)

Understanding emerging diseases affecting forest ecosystems through ecology and genomics.

:::
